s1.syndrome_frame: Palpitations and syncope in a patient with complex congenital heart disease
salient_findings: Tachycardia with heart rate of 183 bpm
Irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating on ECG
key_facts: Patient has complex congenital heart disease
Patient has D-transposition of the great arteries
Patient has single ventricle physiology
Patient has a large ventricular septal defect with outflow extension
Patient has Fontan circulation
Patient was prescribed diltiazem and apixaban
Patient experienced persistent tachycardia and palpitations
ECG showed irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating
Transesophageal echocardiogram showed no intracardiac thrombus
ECG after diltiazem administration showed regular narrow complex tachycardia
ECG with adenosine showed temporary heart block with continuation of supraventricular tachycardia

shortlist.label: Intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has Fontan circulation and history of complex congenital heart disease, which increases the risk of intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia

shortlist.label: Atrial fibrillation
shortlist.why_kept: ECG showed irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating, consistent with atrial fibrillation

shortlist.label: Atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Patient experienced persistent tachycardia and palpitations, and ECG after diltiazem administration showed regular narrow complex tachycardia

shortlist.label: Orthodromic atrioventricular reentrant tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of congenital heart disease and Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome is a possible underlying condition

shortlist.label: Focal atrial tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: ECG showed irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating, and patient has a history of complex congenital heart disease

raw.rationale: The patient's ECG showed irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating, which is consistent with intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia, a common complication in patients with Fontan circulation and complex congenital heart disease.

rejected.label: Atrial fibrillation
rejected.why: Atrial fibrillation typically presents with an irregularly irregular rhythm without grouped beating.

rejected.label: Atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia
rejected.why: The ECG after adenosine administration showed temporary heart block with continuation of supraventricular tachycardia, which is not typical for atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia.

rejected.label: Orthodromic atrioventricular reentrant tachycardia
rejected.why: The ECG did not show evidence of pre-excitation or retrograde conduction, which is typical for orthodromic atrioventricular reentrant tachycardia.

rejected.label: Focal atrial tachycardia
rejected.why: Focal atrial tachycardia typically presents with a regular, monomorphic P wave morphology, which is not seen in this patient's ECG.
